methodology:
MP Evans expanded from 4-row to 7-row breakdown including plasma carve-out. CRITICAL CHANGE: 16,600 ha plasma estates (~41K acres) carved out via excludeFromAcreTotals=true. Plasma is owned by local communities around MPE's estates — managed under scheme-smallholder contracts where MPE buys FFB at regulated price but doesn't own the land.

Cluster breakdown (NUCLEUS ACRES — net of plasma):
- North Sumatra (37.9K ac): most mature with multiple mills
- South Sumatra Musi Rawas (20.9K ac): 6th mill commissioned 2024
- Aceh (19K ac): smaller mature cluster
- Bangka-Belitung (19K ac): offshore Sumatra mining-rehabilitation
- East Kalimantan Bumi Mas mature (24.5K ac): primary KAL cluster
- East Kalimantan ABK expansion (13.4K ac): 2025 new planting at immature discount
- Plasma scheme-smallholder partnerships (41K acres EXCLUDED): NOT MPE-owned

Total nucleus: 134.6K acres = 54.3K ha. Total managed (incl plasma): 175K acres = 70.9K ha per MP Evans FY24 disclosure.

USD-reporting + GBp-listing structure unchanged. Per-acre values reduced ~23% across all six nucleus rows to back out plasma proportionally.
